newsitem.title: NORWAY: Oslo bourse rallies to another record close.
newsitem.headline: Oslo bourse rallies to another record close.

text.p: Norwegian stocks raced to new records on Thursday bouyed by strong overseas markets and the firming dollar, dealers said.
Oslo's Total share index rose to an intra-day high of 1,291.16 points. It finished at 1,288,67 points, up 0.79 percent on Wednesday's session for the second consecutive record close.
Turnover was high at 1.08 billion crowns.
"The index will probably drop a few points tomorrow," a dealer said. "It is only natural. We still see a strong market in the next three weeks, but we expect it to be volatile."
Pharmaceutical group Nycomed's A share rose 3.05 percent to 152 crowns amid buying by foreign investors, dealers said.
Industrial group Norsk Hydro climbed 0.89 percent to 397.50 crowns.
Den norske Bank (DnB) and Christiania Bank og Kreditkasse, both of which are expected to present strong first-half 1997 results next week, rose 1.26 percent and 1.13 percent respectively.
DnB closed at 32.10 crowns and Christiania at 26.90 crowns.
